headline: Rain arrives Thursday — harvest overdue onions and potatoes.
weather_notes: Water both zones today — 2 days since Aug 9 irrigation at 97°F exceeds the 1-day heat re-water threshold; don't skip for today's 19% storm chance.
Plan harvesting and outdoor work for Wednesday morning — 92°F with 30% storm chance is the last workable window before Thursday's 90% storm system closes the yard.
Shade e1–e4 tomato beds by 11 AM today and Wednesday — Phoenix harvest opens Aug 24 and 92–97°F sustains sunscald risk through Wednesday.
Skip irrigation Thursday — 90%+ storm chance should bring measurable rain; reassess zones on Friday after seeing Thursday's totals.
